title: Add a .pre-commit-config.yaml running a pinned gitleaks hook to onfinance-db-model-master
description: Create .pre-commit-config.yaml at the root of applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master (repo onfinance-db-model-master, default branch master, pinned HEAD 70b3633e171a1b8d389b27bb901c84c34a0e9bf6) defining a gitleaks hook that scans every commit, mirroring the sdlc/policy.json secrets gate (ciGates: gate secrets, tool gitleaks, blocking, minSeverityToBlock low; secretsManagement.scanningInCi true) so the policy secret scan reaches this repo even though its ciSystem is none. Pin the hook rev to a released gitleaks tag, never a mutable branch, and add no SKIP or --no-verify bypass script. Constraints: db-models is a dev-only Python library with no runtime environment, sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess defines no deploymentWindows and no change freeze applies; keep the change to the single new file, and demonstrate in the PR that the hook aborts a commit containing a clearly-marked fake test credential while pre-commit run --all-files passes on the current tree (no secret at HEAD). Rollback: git revert of the single commit.
acceptanceCriteria: git -C applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master ls-files lists .pre-commit-config.yaml tracked on master

The hook runs gitleaks on every commit, pinned to a released tag, matching the sdlc/policy.json secrets gate (gitleaks, blocking, minSeverityToBlock low), with no SKIP or --no-verify bypass added among the tracked files
The PR record shows a commit attempt containing a clearly-marked fake test credential aborted by the hook with a non-zero exit and no commit object created
pre-commit run --all-files exits 0 on the current tree (no secret committed at HEAD 70b3633e171a1b8d389b27bb901c84c34a0e9bf6)

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the merged .pre-commit-config.yaml diff on master: the hook repo, pinned released rev and id mirror the sdlc/policy.json secrets gate (gitleaks, blocking at low), no bypass script exists among the tracked files, and the PR record shows the blocked fake-credential commit attempt plus a passing pre-commit run --all-files. Expected result: the config exists, is pinned, blocks the planted test credential and passes on the clean tree.

rootCause.description: No local secrets-scanning control was ever implemented in onfinance-db-model-master: only .gitignore, setup.py and the two package files are tracked, so with ciSystem none there is nowhere for the policy gitleaks gate to run for this repo.
